Check state-wise updates By Trending Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 09, 2026, 04:58:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis School Holiday Tomorrow: On November 10, 2026, school operations will vary across India due to regional festivals. For example, Himachal Pradesh and Rajasthan will observe school closures for Diwali festivities, while schools in Delhi-NCR and Uttar Pradesh are expected to operate under a hybrid teaching model. Additionally, confirmed holidays will lead to school closures in West Bengal and Bihar. Parents and students should stay updated through local school announcements.
 Agencies School holiday tomorrow, November 10, 2026: Will schools be closed due to weather and Diwali vacations? Check state-wise updates
 Schools across several states may remain closed tomorrow, November 10, 2026, due to Diwali-related holidays and regional festivals. While some states observe public holidays on this occasion, school closures may vary depending on local government orders, district-level announcements and individual school calendars. Students, parents and teachers are advised to check official school notifications and state education department updates for confirmation.
 School Holiday Tomorrow, November 10: State-Wise Status
 Delhi-NCR school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools across Delhi-NCR, including Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Ghaziabad and Faridabad, are likely to continue operating on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, as no blanket school closure order has been announced so far. However, amid worsening air pollution, government and private schools in Delhi have been directed to conduct classes up to Class 5 in hybrid mode, allowing students to attend online or offline. The hybrid-class directive also covers selected NCR cities. Parents and students should check school notifications for the latest updates on physical attendance and online classes.
 Himachal Pradesh School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Himachal Pradesh will remain closed on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, as part of the five-day Diwali vacation announced for the state. The holiday break, which began on November 6, will continue until November 10, giving students and teachers time to celebrate the festival with their families. Government and recognised schools across the state are expected to follow the holiday schedule. Parents and students should check with their respective school authorities for any local changes.
 Uttar Pradesh school holiday tomorrow 
 Live Events
 Schools across Uttar Pradesh, including Noida, Ghaziabad, Lucknow, Kanpur and other districts, are expected to remain open on Tuesday, November 10, 2026. No statewide school holiday has been listed for November 10. However, individual schools or district administrations may announce separate closures. Parents and students are advised to check with their respective school authorities for the latest updates.
 West Bengal school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools across West Bengal, including Kolkata and other districts, are expected to remain closed on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, due to the additional holiday for Kali Puja. However, private schools, including CBSE and ICSE-affiliated institutions, may follow separate academic calendars. Parents and students should check their respective school notifications for confirmation.
 Bihar School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Bihar will remain closed on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, as part of the extended Diwali and Chhath Puja vacation. However, private schools may follow separate holiday schedules, so parents and students should check with their respective institutions for confirmation.
 Odisha School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Odisha are expected to remain open on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, as no statewide school holiday has been announced for the day. Parents and students should check with their respective school authorities for any district-specific holiday announcements or changes to the academic schedule.
 Rajasthan School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Rajasthan, including Jaipur, Jodhpur, Udaipur, Kota, Ajmer and other districts, will remain closed on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, as part of the 12-day Diwali vacation announced in the state's school academic calendar. However, private schools may follow separate vacation schedules, so parents and students should check with their respective school authorities for confirmation.
 Chhattisgarh School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Chhattisgarh will remain closed on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, as part of the extended Diwali vacation.
